exposure: mode of delivery (spontaneous vaginal birth, elective CS, emergency CS)
circadian timing of delivery (morning vs. afternoon/evening)
cohort: The study included 15 stillbirths and 46 newborns delivered by spontaneous vaginal birth, elective, or emergency cesarean sections.
finding: Adrenaline and noradrenaline levels were significantly higher in stillbirths compared to newborns, and also higher in acute versus chronic fetal distress.
mod_finding: Cortisol levels were significantly higher in newborns delivered by spontaneous vaginal delivery compared to elective cesarean sections.
